newsitem.title: USA: NRC briefs Northeast on Conn. nuke problems.
newsitem.headline: NRC briefs Northeast on Conn. nuke problems.

text.p: Northeast Utilities (NU) came under new criticism Wednesday for what the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) called operational shortcomings at its Connecticut Yankee nuclear power plant.
These latest concerns were aired by a team of NRC inspectors, briefing NU officials on the findings of their latest inspection of the Haddam Neck, Conn., facility.

The 582 megawatt plant, shut in July for maintenance and refueling, now needs NRC approval to reopen after safety concerns at NU's three Millstone power plants led to a shutdown of all four of the utility's nuclear facilities.
